name: calimia-seo-desk
description: Calimia Home SEO Desk: scores every Shopify product and collection, fixes meta titles, meta descriptions, image file names and alt text with your approval, and flags new products that need SEO.

shopifyServer.title: Shopify MCP server
shopifyServer.description: The Shopify connector's name as /mcp lists it.

adminStore.title: Shopify admin store handle
adminStore.description: The part after /store/ in your Shopify admin URL, for the Open links.

titleFormat.title: SEO title format
titleFormat.description: product-vendor-brand: 'Product | Vendor | Calimia Home'; product-brand: 'Product | Calimia Home'. Parts are dropped to fit 60 characters.

metaModel.title: Model for meta descriptions
metaModel.description: Alias or model id used to write meta descriptions.

rescanMinutes.title: Minutes between change checks
rescanMinutes.description: How often the open session checks Shopify for changed products (10 or more).

newDays.title: Days a product counts as new
newDays.description: New products with SEO issues are listed first and raise the banner.

renameFiles.title: Offer file renames
renameFiles.description: Offer to rename hash and screenshot image file names to the product handle.

houseRulesInPrompt.title: Teach Claude the house SEO rules
houseRulesInPrompt.description: Add the Calimia SEO house rules to Claude's system prompt so products Claude writes follow them.
